answer_1.quote: We propose Mustango, a text-to-music diffusion model with our novel MuNet module to explicitly guide the music generation towards input tempo, key, chords, and general textual description.
answer_1.outputs: music audio clips conditioned on text prompts with musical attributes such as tempo, key, chords, and beats

answer_2.quote: The quality of the generated audio samples is evaluated using three objective metrics: Fréchet Distance (FD), Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD) , and Kullback-Leibler divergence (KL)... We define nine metrics (all represented in percentage; in the case of binary values, 100 stands for true and 0 for false) to evaluate whether the music properties in the generated music match the text prompts.
automatic_metrics: Chord Match in any Order major/minor Type (CMOT)

answer_4.quote: We conducted two rounds of subjective evaluation, each consisting of a general and an expert listening test that focuses on controllability... A total of 48 participants participated in the first round of the general listening test, of which 26 had more than five years of formal musical training.
answer_4.guideline: The participants were asked to rate the: i) audio rendering quality (AQ), ii) relevance of the audio with the input text prompt (REL), iii) overall musical quality (OMQ), iv) rhythm consistency (RC), and v) harmony and consonance of music (HC)... For the expert listening test, we added two additional music control-specific aspects to rate the degree to which the chords and tempo from the generated music match the text prompt. We denote them as MCM and MTM (musical chord/tempo match).
